jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Daylight is a security services company delivering Managed Agentic Security Services (MASS), including MDR, threat hunting, security data lake, and more, through a fundamentally different architecture than traditional security services providers.

Daylight's architecture combines an agentic platform that runs the full cycle from detection to response with security experts from IR and threat hunting backgrounds. The platform collects identity and business context across systems to investigate alerts and continuously learns your environment. Security experts validate decisions, feed insights into the platform, optimize detections, and take over in case of an incident.

The result: security teams move from firefighting to strategic work.

We’re looking for a  Senior Product Manager to join our team and lead key product areas, from identifying customer needs and shaping solutions to driving execution and adoption.

Responsibilities:

- Lead product vision, strategy, and roadmap for key areas of the MASS platform.

- Design agentic workflows and automation experiences that balance autonomy, clarity, and control.

- Run tight discovery loops with security teams to uncover and validate real customer needs.

- Translate insights into clear product narratives, priorities, and success metrics.

- Partner closely with engineering and design to ship high-quality products quickly.

- Drive GTM alignment, launch planning, and customer adoption.

- Challenge traditional product processes and help define new ways of building that match the pace and potential of AI.

- Foster a culture of velocity, experimentation, and crisp execution.

What We’re Looking For:

- 5+ years of product management experience, including at least 4 years in cybersecurity - a must.

- Strong technical depth and comfort working with AI agents, automation pipelines, and data workflows.

- Proven ability to ship impactful products in fast-paced or early-stage environments.

- Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to make complex ideas simple.

- Strong analytical mindset and familiarity with metrics, experimentation, and product instrumentation.

- Ability to operate across strategy, execution, and cross-functional leadership.
